stoppingDistanceDisplay.perceptionField: signal_range.distance_m: RGB body-forward depth at capture, projected along the current vehicle forward axis; not a fixed-track-plane gap
stoppingDistanceDisplay.controllerPolicyField: semantic.status.signal_approach.target_stop_distance_m: lower-bound policy, not nominal requested gap
stoppingDistanceDisplay.evaluationField: actual_front_gap_m: independent evaluator-only leading bumper corner clearance to the fixed track signal plane

corridorDisplay.inferred: candidate.corridor.source=current_right_inferred: ESTIMATED center from the current measured right boundary and a recorded scalar width prior; orange ABC
corridorDisplay.inferredLeft: candidate.corridor.source=current_left_identity_checked_native: ESTIMATED center from CURRENT left; native_left_width_m is the native asymmetric ABC compensation parameter, distinct from the paired width/identity prior. left_identity_match.accepted is displayed only as recorded. No measured-center claim or fabricated center cloud.
corridorDisplay.paired: candidate.corridor_debug.target_type=observed_center with left+right clouds: MEASURED L+R boundaries with a derived center
corridorDisplay.rawClouds: candidate.raw_clouds: dim context dots; candidate.clouds: colored current selected geometry
corridorDisplay.widthAge: candidate.corridor.calibration_age_at_capture/max_calibration_age_sec: age at capture and recorded limit, not freshness extended by video rendering
corridorDisplay.semanticGuard: semantic.corridor_guard: worker-recorded VALID/EXPIRED and calibration_age_sec/max_age_sec; frozen values explicitly marked Last
corridorDisplay.gate: semantic.status.velocity_gate_reason remains separate from semantic.status.traffic_reason; width expiry is a command gate, not a light state
